mcp.title: Connected tools
mcp.subtitle: MCP servers let omp use outside tools, such as a database or a ticket tracker.
mcp.projectConfigOff: omp is set to ignore servers defined in projects (mcp.enableProjectConfig is off), so the servers below aren't used.

empty.userTitle: No tools connected for all projects
empty.projectTitle: No tools connected for this project
empty.body: Add a server to let omp use an outside tool, like GitHub, a database or your notes.

mcp.readOnly: Set up in {{source}} ({{path}}). omp reads this file without changing it, so edit it there.
mcp.noTools: No tools found. Check the command.

status.noTools: Connected, but it offers no tools

toast.saved: Saved {{name}}. New chats will use it.
toast.signInBody: This server signs you in through your browser. In a chat, type /mcp reauth {{name}} to connect.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: omp will stop using this server. It's deleted from {{path}}.

tools.title: Tools from {{name}}
tools.extras: It also offers {{prompts}} prompt templates and {{resources}} resources.

test.authRequired: The server requires sign-in. Save it, then type /mcp reauth {{name}} in a chat, or add an Authorization header.
test.unresolved: These variables aren't set on this computer: {{vars}}

gallery.title: Add a server
gallery.subtitle: Pick a popular tool, or set up your own.
gallery.customBody: Run a program on this computer or connect to a web address.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: How omp refers to this server. Letters, numbers and - _ . : work.
form.commandHint: The program omp starts, with its options.
form.envHint: For secrets like API keys. ${NAME} uses a variable already set on this computer.
form.sseHint: Only if the server's docs say so.
form.headersHint: Sent with every request, e.g. Authorization: Bearer ${API_TOKEN}.
form.requires: This server needs {{bins}} installed on this computer.
form.scopeHint: “All projects” saves it to your omp settings; “This project” saves it to the project's .omp folder.

errors.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, - _ . : and single spaces (up to 100 characters).
errors.nameTaken: A server with this name already exists there.
errors.commandRequired: Enter the command that starts the server.
errors.urlInvalid: The address should start with https:// or http://.

skills.title: Skills & plugins
skills.subtitle: Install and manage the skills and plugins omp can use.
skills.allOff: Skills are turned off in omp's settings, so none of these are used.
skills.emptyProject: This project has no skills of its own
skills.emptyBody: Skills are short instruction files that teach omp how to do something. Browse the registry to add some.
skills.invalid_one: {{count}} skill file has a problem, so omp skips it:
skills.invalid_other: {{count}} skill files have problems, so omp skips them:

reason.skillsOff: All skills are turned off in omp's settings.
reason.sourceDisabled: Skills from this source are turned off in omp's settings.
reason.ignored: Hidden by an ignore pattern in omp's settings.
reason.notIncluded: Not in the list of skills omp's settings allow.
reason.duplicate: Another copy of this skill is used instead.

skills.offline: Can't reach the registry. Showing installed skills only.
skills.noRegistryInstalls: No skills installed from the registry

scripts.title: {{name}} includes scripts
scripts.body: This skill comes with programs omp can run on your computer. Only install it if you trust who published it.

drawer.enabledHint: When off, omp won't load it in new chats.
drawer.whenAuto: omp reads the description above and uses this skill when your request matches it. You can also ask for it directly:
drawer.whenHidden: Only when you ask for it by name. omp doesn't pick it on its own:

plugins.emptyProject: No plugins installed just for this project
plugins.emptyBody: Plugins add tools, commands and skills to omp. Open Available to install one.
plugins.shadowed: A copy installed for this project is used instead.
plugins.installByNameHint: An npm package, a GitHub repo (github:owner/repo), a local folder, or name@marketplace.
plugins.offline: Can't reach your plugin marketplaces. Showing installed plugins only.
plugins.noMarketplacesBody: No plugin marketplaces are set up. You can still install any plugin by name above.

memory.title: What omp remembers
memory.subtitle: Notes omp keeps between chats so it doesn't start from scratch.
memory.off: Memory is off, so omp doesn't remember anything between chats right now. You can turn it on in omp's settings (memory.backend). Anything saved earlier is still shown here.
memory.remote: Memories are kept on your Hindsight server ({{url}}). They can't be browsed or deleted from here.
memory.readOnly: omp maintains these memories itself and rewrites them when it tidies up, so they can't be deleted from here.
memory.cantDelete: omp rewrites this one itself when it tidies up its memories, so it can't be deleted here.
memory.empty: omp hasn't saved any memories yet.
memory.more_one: {{count}} more. Search to narrow the list.
memory.more_other: {{count}} more. Search to narrow the list.

forgetOne.title: Forget “{{name}}”?
forgetOne.body: omp won't remember this anymore. This can't be undone.

forgetAll.title: Forget everything?
forgetAll.body: omp will forget the memories it can delete in {{scope}}. This can't be undone.
forgetAll.keeps: Summaries omp maintains itself will stay; they're rebuilt from what's left.

toast.restartHint: Chats that are already open may keep using it until they restart.

usage.title: Usage & limits
usage.subtitle: What your chats cost this week, and how much of your plan is left.
usage.empty: No usage yet this week. Costs appear here after your first chats.
usage.refreshLimits: Check limits again with your providers
usage.noLimitsBody: Limits appear here when you're signed in to a provider that reports them, like Claude or ChatGPT plans.
usage.estimateNote: Costs are estimates at public API prices, as recorded by omp. Plan subscriptions may bill differently.
usage.statusTooltip: Estimated cost of today's chats. Click for usage and limits.
